test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All papayas are oranges.

Some oranges are apples.

Conclusions:

(I) At least some apples are oranges.

(II) Some papayas are apples.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusion I and II follow

solution:
The least possible venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a4624b54ab723b3bdc819cdd8e7b3f41ffdec9419328530661aac62f15a4e41.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) At least some apples are oranges → True( As, Some oranges are apples. So, At least some apples are oranges holds true)

(II) Some papayas are apples → False( As, there is no direction between them).

Thus, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
